label: ERCOT TPIT — July 13, 2026

source.locator: Four TPIT project sheets, rows 3 onward (excluding contact column J); RTPProjects rows 2:90 supplemental only

geographicScope: ERCOT planning footprint in Texas; not all Texas transmission, and no per-record state or center is inferred.
inventoryScope: Source-assigned TPIT component records: explicit transmission-equipment evidence and useful unresolved/distribution planning context. Completed/cancelled, explicit in-service and model-only entries excluded; RTP rows are supplemental context, not additional active projects.
limitations: All source records remain unlocated; named terminals/counties and bus references are not native geometry.
TPIT component counts are not unique engineering-project totals. Five exact non-contact duplicate rows are coalesced with both locators.
Only explicit accepted equipment quantities establish transmission-project scope; zero/missing quantities leave other useful records as planning-context.
Conceptual and absent status remain unknown; source tab/status and actual-date conflicts are preserved rather than resolved through date arithmetic.
Usable TPIT milestone fields retain displayed month precision; stored days/minutes are not day-level evidence. Year 9999 cells stay unknown with raw evidence preserved.
Owner tokens are source-scoped; unresolved/composite tokens do not become singular owner identities or globally distinct companies.
RTP records may overlap TPIT and have blank status; absent links do not establish uniqueness or cancellation.
Public raw data reused for analysis under ERCOT Terms of Use section 5; source attribution does not imply ERCOT endorsement.
